title: Missing EmailSubmissionFilter type alias
description: EmailFilterCondition has EmailFilter = Filter<EmailFilterCondition> type alias in query.rs. EmailSubmissionFilterCondition has no corresponding EmailSubmissionFilter alias. The doc comment on EmailSubmissionFilterCondition references Filter<EmailSubmissionFilterCondition> by spelling it out, but a type alias would be consistent and save users from writing the full generic. Should define type EmailSubmissionFilter = Filter<EmailSubmissionFilterCondition> in submission.rs and re-export it from lib.rs.
